# dsh-assist
**Your AI companion, with reusable personas, memory, and opt-in proactive chat.**
A community plugin for **DeepSeek Harness Desktop**.
English · 简体中文 · Download · Documentation
## English
Turn a Harness conversation into a reusable AI companion: choose a persona, retain useful memories,
and let it start a brief conversation after a period of inactivity.
> **Preview release.** Targets Harness Desktop **0.2.1-rc.3**. Offline tests pass. Windows Desktop i
nstallation/loading was verified for v0.3.0; v0.3.1 keeps the same runtime. Real-model proactive cha
t and the revised voice remain unverified. This is an independent community project, not an official
voice remain unverified. This is an independent community project, not an official DeepSeek product.
### What is new in v0.3.1?
**A more natural voice for the default fish daughter.** Replies can end naturally, without a routine
follow-up question or service menu. The persona uses fewer stock affectionate phrases and includes
short dialogue examples. Opt-in idle chat and restart recovery from v0.3.0 remain available.
Download the plugin · Install and enable · Send trial feedback
We are looking for early testers on **Windows + Harness Desktop 0.2.1-rc.3**. Tell us where installa
tion, activation, restart recovery, or stopping worked or failed. The one-minute trial helps collect
reproducible results; model calls use your normal quota. No need to share private conversations or
results; model calls use your normal quota. No need to share private conversations or memory files.
### What it does
| Capability | Behavior |

| Portable personas | Versioned JSON packs with identity, voice, greeting, and memory guidance |
| P
ersistent memory | Long-term notes shared within a persona; short-term checkpoints scoped to a sessi

on |
| Proactive chat | Opt-in idle triggers with cooldowns, quiet hours, and an unanswered-message

limit |
| Shareable packs | Public exports omit stored memories; private backups require an explicit

option |
| Inspectable data | Local JSON storage, CLI tools, and documented formats |
### Meet the default companion
**Rice-Loving Chubby Fish Daughter** — **爱吃白饭的大肥鱼女儿** — is a playful fictional fish who loves a bowl
of plain steamed rice. She calls you “爸爸” (“Dad”) by default; you can change that address at any ti
me. The bundled persona speaks Chinese by default; ask for another language if preferred.
> “Dad, I'm here.”
Her voice is meant to be brief and conversational: no routine follow-up questions or service menus,
and no obligatory rice jokes or affectionate catchphrases. Questions are welcome when the conversati
on actually needs one. The examples guide the tone; they are not fixed replies.
**Availability:** The v0.3.1 downloads include the updated persona, selected automatically when init
ializing fresh storage. Existing installations retain their saved roles and memories; see how to try
the updated persona.
**Role ID:** `little-fish` · **Definition:** packs/fish.json

Get the files from the v0.3.1 release.

Complete source for development |

### Installation
The commands below use **Windows PowerShell**. Desktop supplies its own runtime; a separate system N
ode.js/npm installation is not required for plugin installation.
1. Launch Harness Desktop once to initialize its profile. Use **Manage dsh Command…** in the applica

tion menu to install or repair its `dsh` command.
2. **Fully quit Desktop.** Closing the window may

only hide it.
3. Open a new PowerShell terminal. Verify that `dsh` comes from Desktop and reports `0
.2.1-rc.3`, then install the downloaded package:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Adjust the path if your download is elsewhere. Stop if a command fails. Reopen Desktop after install
the path if your download is elsewhere. Stop if a command fails. Reopen Desktop after installation.
An npm-installed standalone `dsh` cannot modify Desktop's profile. See the installation and troubles
hooting guide for source-folder installation and existing-user migration.
### Enable proactive chat
In the target conversation, ask:
> Use `assist_list`, select `little-fish` with `assist_use`, and read `assist_memory_read`. Then cal
l `assist_idle_start`: chat after 15 idle minutes, wait at least 30 minutes between triggers, pause
after two unanswered triggers, and stay quiet from 23:00 to 08:00.
**Enabled means the tool returned `enabled: true`**, not merely that the model said it would remind

| Action | Tool |

| Enable or change settings | `assist_idle_start` |
| Inspect this conversation | `assist_idle_statu

s` |
| Stop future triggers | `assist_idle_stop` |
Quiet hours use the backend's local timezone. The backend must remain running; saved opt-ins resume
when the original session is loaded after restart, after a fresh idle/cooldown wait. New sessions st
ay off. Stop also forgets the saved opt-in. Each trigger uses the selected model and incurs normal u
sage. Stop does not retract a turn already submitted.
[该节后续省略]
### Data and development
Memory lives in `DSH_ASSIST_HOME`, otherwise `DSH_HOME/dsh-assist`, or `~/.dsh/dsh-assist` when neit
her variable is set. Public export filters stored memory fields; it does not redact personal informa
tion written into the persona itself.
[该节后续省略]
### 功能概览
| 能力 | 说明 |

| 可移植人设 | 用版本化 JSON 封装身份、说话风格、开场白和记忆规则 |
| 持久记忆 | 长期记忆按角色共享，短期摘要按会话保存 |
| 主动聊天 | 显式开启后按空闲时间触发，支持冷却、安

静时段和无人回应上限 |
| 角色分享 | 公开导出不含已存记忆，私人备份需要明确选择 |
| 可检查数据 | 本地 JSON 存储，配套 CLI 和格式文档 |
